mapper.sql: rid, heart_rate, Entry_Time, Is_Del, Env, Data_Source, E_User_Id
mapper.select: SELECT m.time, CONCAT( '用户**', '上传了', m.`type` ) NAME FROM ( SELECT type, MAX( id ) AS max_time FROM monitor_insert_log GROUP BY type ) AS latest_times JOIN monitor_insert_log m ON m.type = latest_times.type AND m.id = latest_times.max_time INNER JOIN yh_user_reginfo AS yur ON yur.user_code = m.usercode where yur.User_Type = 5 and yur.Org_Code like concat(#{orgId}, '%') ORDER BY m.time DESC

select ifnull(count(*),0) heart_num, ifnull(ROUND(avg(yuhr.heart_rate),1),0) heart_avg from yh_user_reginfo reg left join yh_user_heart_rate yuhr on reg.user_code = yuhr.E_User_Id where reg.User_Type = 5 and reg.Org_Code like concat(#{orgId},'%')

select ifnull(count(*),0) oxygen_num, ifnull(ROUND(avg(yuo.oxygen),1),0) oxygen_avg from yh_user_reginfo reg left join yh_user_oxygen yuo on reg.user_code = yuo.E_User_Id where reg.User_Type = 5 and reg.Org_Code like concat(#{orgId},'%') and yuo.oxygen>0

select ifnull(count(*),0) numBloodGate, ifnull(ROUND(avg(yub.Sbp),1),0) sbp_avg, ifnull(ROUND(avg(yub.Dbp),1),0) dbp_avg from yh_user_reginfo reg left join yh_user_bloodpressure yub on reg.user_code = yub.E_User_Id where reg.User_Type = 5 and reg.Org_Code like concat(#{orgId},'%')

select ifnull(count(*),0) numBloodSugar, ifnull(ROUND(AVG(yub.Bs),1),0) AS postprandialAverage from yh_user_reginfo reg left join yh_user_bloodsuger yub on reg.user_code = yub.E_User_Id where reg.User_Type = 5 and reg.Org_Code like concat(#{orgId}, '%') and yub.Bs>0

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) AS num, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(yubf.bodyAge), 1), 0) AS bodyAge, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(yubf.fat_rate), 1), 0) AS fat_rate, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(yubf.muscle), 1), 0) AS muscle, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(yubfs.json_data, '$.visfat', -1), ',', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 1), 0) AS visfat, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(yubfs.json_data, '$.bmi', -1), ',', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 1), 0) AS bmi FROM yh_user_reginfo reg LEFT JOIN yh_user_body_fat yubf ON reg.user_code = yubf.E_User_Id LEFT JOIN yh_user_body_fat_scale AS yubfs ON yubfs.wubf_id = yubf.wubf_id WHERE reg.User_Type = 5 AND reg.Org_Code LIKE CONCAT(#{orgId}, '%')

select IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ysud.sleep_time, ysud.wake_time)), 1), 0) sleep_total from yh_user_reginfo reg left join yh_sleep_user_diary ysud on reg.user_code = ysud.user_code where reg.User_Type = 5 and reg.Org_Code like concat(#{orgId}, '%')

SELECT ysd.number FROM yh_user_reginfo reg LEFT JOIN yh_sport_diary ysd ON reg.user_code = ysd.user_code WHERE reg.User_Type = 5 AND reg.Org_Code LIKE concat( #{orgId}, '%' ) AND ysd.number IS NOT NULL

select (select count(*) from yh_user_heart_rate where E_User_Id=#{eUserId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and Is_Del = 2) as num, xy.Data_Source,xy.Entry_Time,xy.heart_rate from yh_user_reginfo as reg left join yh_user_heart_rate xy on reg.user_code = xy.E_User_Id where xy.rid = (select rid from yh_user_heart_rate where E_User_Id=#{eUserId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and Is_Del = 2 order by Entry_Time desc limit 1);
SELECT FROM yh_user_heart_rate WHERE E_user_id=#{usercode} and is_Del=2 ORDER BY Entry_Time DESC LIMIT 1
